description: Read-only historical normal-log diagnosis for one exact configured credential/businessUnit and query or script key. Reads only bounded project/logs timestamp files, never error companions or authentication/session contents. Requires caller-managed quiescence. Supports only mcdev 10.1.0 canonical retrieve credential/BU type key with literal selectors and no options, aliases or quotes, within an explicit UTC ISO millisecond window of at most 24 hours. Returns finite observations and validated basename/time provenance, never raw logs, paths, errors, secrets or remote completeness. No subprocess, network, native execution, elicitation or rerun. Current retrieval tools use --noLogFile; absent evidence is no-match, not a reason to repeat retrieval. Unknown records are suppressed; investigate manually when evidence is insufficient.
name: diagnose_mcdev_retrieve_logs
